agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  CITY OF AVALON
  Wednesday, August 17 at 5:00 p.m.
  410 Avalon Canyon Road, Avalon

 In compliance with the Americans with Disability Act, if you need special assistance to participate in
 this meeting, please contact Denise Radde, City Clerk (310) 510-0220. Notification 48 hours prior to
 the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this
 meeting. (28 CFR 35. 102-35.104 ADA Title II). All public records relating to an agenda item on this
 agenda are available for the public inspection at the time the records are distributed to all, or a majority
 of all, members of the Planning Commission. Such records shall be available at City Hall located at
 410 Avalon Canyon Road.

Due to health recommendations from the Center for Disease Control and State of California
Division of Occupational Safety and Health (Cal/OSHA), and the declared state of emergency
wherein social distancing measures have been imposed or recommended, the CITY OF
AVALON'S CITY COUNCIL and PLANNING COMMISSION MEETINGS SHALL
GENERALLY BE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC REMOTELY. The general public may
attend the meeting in the Council Chambers however must adhere to social distancing
requirements and wear a mask or face covering at all times. The public is encouraged to watch
and participate from the safety of their homes while practicing social distancing.

Council Chambers are open to a maximum 30 members of the general public. Once the Council
Chambers reach maximum occupancy, the general public may participate in Oral
Communication and address the Planning Commission on an agenda item in-person by waiting
in the City Hall Court Yard and entering the Chambers one at a time at the appropriate time. No
one will be admitted into the Council Chambers who is ill or exhibiting symptoms of COVID-19.
All individuals entering the Council Chambers must wear a mask or face covering at all times.
Additionally, the general public may participate in Oral Communication and address the
Planning Commission on an agenda item by providing comments via e-Comment.

  The meeting can be viewed:
  On local cable: Catalina Broadband Solutions channel 3
  Streaming Online: www.cityofavalon.com/meetings
  *Streaming on Facebook Live: www.facebook.com/CityOfAvalonOfficial

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE/ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

  1. MINUTES
   Although the live recording is the official record of public meetings, actions are prepared
  for the Planning Commission’s approval.

  Recommended Action
  Approve the actions from the July 20, 2022 regular Planning Commission Meeting.

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

1. Request for approval of a Site Plan (Section 9-8.201 et seq. of the Avalon Municipal Code
  (“AMC”)) for the remodel the lower portion of an existing two story duplex, categorically
  exempt from environmental review under Section 15301 of the State CEQA Guidelines –
  Existing Facilities. The project is in the Coastal Zone but is exempt from a Coastal
  Development Permit as an “improvement to a multi family residence.” The Planning
  Commission will determine whether the project is within the 300-foot appealable seaward
  area boundary. The associated entitlements (site plan) require Planning Commission review
  but no public hearing.

  Owner:  Olov & Jenny Nasielle
  Location:  215 Beacon Street
  APN:  780-030-005
  PC#:  2799
  Zone:  High Density Residential (HD-R) Zone
  ]File Date:  06-01-2022
  Files:  SP

PUBLIC HEARING:

1. An application for Phase II of an ongoing remodel at 201 E Whittley, involving a revision
  to the previously granted site plan (SP) and setback variance (V), an additional variance for
  exceeding the maximum allowed floor area ratio (FAR), and no changes to the approved
  frontage encroachment. The project includes the construction of a second story and roof
  top deck on an existing one-story, 576 square foot single-family residence. The proposed
  addition is completely within the existing building footprint and does not extend any
  further into the setback than previously approved for Phase I. The second floor would add
  485 square feet of livable space consisting of one (1) bedroom, one (1) bathroom, one (1)
  office space, a covered deck and exterior stairs leading to the upper level deck (389SF),
  which - combined with Phase I’s reconfigurations - do not require a fresh water allocation.
  The project is in the Coastal Zone but is exempt from a Coastal Development Permit as an
  “improvement to a single family residence.” The Planning Commission will determine
  whether the project is within the 300-foot appealable seaward area boundary. The project
  is Categorically Exempt under State CEQA Guidelines Section 15301– Existing facilities.
   Owner:  Mark and Miriam Pasveer
  Applicant:  Sustainable Construction (Rep. Mark Pasveer)
  Location:  201 E Whittley
  APN:  7480-027-004
  PC#:  2798
  Zone:  High Density Residential (HD-R) Zone
  File Date:  06-01-2022
  Files:  V; SP; NOE

2. A Public Hearing and consideration of a Resolution for an application for a Transient
  Rental License, a Coastal Development Permit and Site Plan Approval to allow the renting
  or leasing of a room or rooms for periods of fewer than thirty (30) consecutive days
  duration (Transient Rental – Section 9-6.602 (a) of the Avalon Municipal Code) in a unit
  within a duplex located at 328 Descanso Avenue. The project is in the Coastal Zone and is
  subject to a Coastal Development Permit, which requires a public hearing and Planning
  Commission approval. The Planning Commission will determine whether the project is
  within the 300-foot appealable seaward area boundary. The project is Categorically
  Exempt under Section 15305 of the State CEQA Guidelines – Minor Alterations in Land
  Use Limitations.

  Owner/Applicant:  Steve and Kelley Smith
  Filing Date:  07/12/2022
  Files:  TRL; CDP; SP;
  Location of Project:  328 Descanso Avenue
  APN:  7480-036-013
  PC #:  2803
  Zone:  High Density Residential (HD-R) Zone (flats)

3. A Public Hearing and consideration of a Resolution for the issuance of a Site Plan
  approval, Conditional Use Permit and a Coastal Development Permit authorizing the
  operation of a Beer Garden (AMC 9-6.203 “restaurants, bars and cafes”) within the
  Commercial “C” zone located Front Street at 301 Crescent Ave. The project is in the
  Coastal Zone and is subject to a Coastal Development Permit, which requires a public
  hearing and Planning Commission approval. The Planning Commission will determine
  whether the project is within the 300-foot appealable seaward area boundary. The project
  is Categorically Exempt under Section 15303(c) of the State CEQA Guidelines – New
  Construction or Conversion of Small Structures.

  Owner/Applicant:  Santa Catalina Island Company
  Files:  CUP; CDP; SP
  Location of Project:  301 Crescent Ave
  APN:  7480-017-005
  PC #:  2804
  Zone:  Commercial
  File Date:  07/13/2022
 4. A Public Hearing and consideration of a Resolution for the issuance of a Site Plan
  approval, Conditional Use Permit, Variance, and a Coastal Development Permit
  authorizing the construction of a new multi-family dwelling on a vacant lot located at 236
  Catalina Ave in the Special Commercial zone. The applicant is requesting approval of a
  side setback variance and a parking variance to accommodate the proposed building plans.
  The project is in the Coastal Zone and is subject to a Coastal Development Permit, which
  requires a public hearing and Planning Commission approval. The Planning Commission
  will determine whether the project is within the 300-foot appealable seaward area
  boundary. The project is Categorically Exempt under Section 15305(b) of the State CEQA
  Guidelines – New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures

  Owner/Applicant:  Rameson Family/Fineline
  Files:  CUP, CDP, V, SP
  Location of Project:  236 Catalina Ave
  APN:  7480-014-036
  Zone:  Special Commercial
  PC #:  2805
  File Date:  6/13/2022

5. General Plan Amendment revising the recently adopted 2021-2029 Planning Cycle
  Housing Element Update and recommending adoption of those changes to the City Council
  via Resolution. In compliance with CEQA Guidelines Section 15164 an Addendum to the
  General Plan FEIR has been prepared which concludes that the proposed updates to the
  General Plan Housing Element do not result in any new or greater environmental impacts
  than were previously analyzed, disclosed, and mitigated.

  Applicant:  City of Avalon
  Filing Date:  07/19/2022
  Files:  GPA
  Location of Project:  City of Avalon Incorporated
  PC #:  2806

ITEMS OF DISCUSSION:

PLANNING DIRECTOR / CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS

COMMISSIONER BUSINESS

BUSINESS FROM THE AUDIENCE

ADJOURN
 Anyone may appeal any decision made by the Commission to the City Council. To appeal, you
must file a written appeal, and include an appeal fee of $1027.00 with the City Clerk within
fifteen (15) calendar days of such action. Any person challenging actions of the Planning
Commission may be limited to issues he or someone else raises in writing prior to or orally at the
hearing. Any person may appeal the Planning Commission’s determination that a proposed
project is seaward of the appealable seaward area boundary to the Coastal Commission, and
following exhaustion of local appeals, any aggrieved person may appeal actions on local Coastal
Development Permits seaward of the appealable area boundary to the Coastal Commission.
